traceability.notes: All functional acceptance criteria and technical requirements for Story 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT are implemented and covered by passing tests. The plugin: - Parses and validates `@supports story-path REQ-ID...` annotations (format-level via valid-annotation-format + valid-implements-utils; deep requirement existence via valid-req-reference). - Treats `@supports` as satisfying both story and requirement presence checks in require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation, while preserving legacy @story/@req behavior. - Supports mixed usage of @story/@req/@supports in the same comment and codebase with explicit tests. - Emits clear error messages that include which story file was checked when requirement validation fails, and scopes requirement IDs per story file. - Provides user-facing documentation (migration guide and README references) explaining @supports usage, examples, and migration strategy. Given the direct linkage between tests and this story file, and the successful verbose test run, this story is fully implemented in this repository.
